title: Siegard plan graph
description: The derived index of a work root. Never authored and never edited: `bin/plan.py` derives it from the markdown plan nodes, and `--check` holds a committed copy to them. Nodes are the files; edges are the references their frontmatter declares. `binds` and `covers` edges point outside the plan, at knowledge-base nodes — the plan's whole reason to exist — so a consumer resolving them opens the knowledge root, not this file.

file.description: The node's file, relative to the work root. Always `<id>.md`.

epic.description: The epic a task sits under, read from its path. Tasks only.

base.description: The base pin the task carries. Tasks only.

unresolved.description: The open gap references this task carries, sorted. Omitted when none. The judgment behind each stays in the task file.

questions.description: How many unresolved questions the task carries — facts no base node holds. Omitted when none; the questions themselves stay in the task file.

to.description: A task of this plan for `depends_on`; a knowledge-base node for `binds` and `covers`.

at.description: Where in the source node the reference sits, so a reader can open the place a defect names.
